claims: Denver International Airport is abbreviated as DIA.
Blucifer is the nickname for the Blue Mustang horse statue.
The Blue Mustang horse statue is 32 feet tall.
The Blue Mustang horse statue is cobalt blue.
The Blue Mustang horse statue has glowing red eyes.
The Blue Mustang horse statue killed its creator Luis Jiménez.
Luis Jiménez created the Blue Mustang horse statue.
Leo Tanguma created murals that are now removed.
Denver International Airport baggage claim has gargoyles.
A capstone is inscribed with "New World Airport Commission".
New World Airport Commission is a non-existent organization.
Some theorists allege the runway layout resembles a Nazi swastika when viewed from above.
DIA officials have debunked the claim that the runway layout resembles a Nazi swastika.
DIA officials note the runway layout's efficient wind-resistant design.
DIA officials have hosted "Conspiracy Theories Uncovered" exhibits.
The "Conspiracy Theories Uncovered" exhibits explain the art and construction.
Denver International Airport has baggage train tunnels.
